title: Learn Systems Administration
tagline: From first servers to reliable, automated infrastructure
description: A three-level curriculum for systems administrators — provisioning and hardening Linux/Windows servers, managing identity and storage, and automating operations so systems stay patchable, observable, and recoverable.
prerequisites: Comfortable with a terminal or PowerShell
Willingness to follow change control and document runbooks

levels.title: Server Foundations
levels.goal: Administer a Linux (and basic Windows) server: users, packages, services, and backups

topics.title: Linux essentials
items: Packages, updates, and service management with systemd

topics.title: Networking on the host
items: SSH hardening (keys, disable password where possible)

topics.title: Storage & backups
items: Disks, mounts, and LVM at a working level

topics.title: Documentation & change
items: Runbooks for reboot, patch, and restore

projects: Provision a Linux VM: users, SSH keys, firewall, and a web service
Automated nightly backup + documented restore test
Patch cycle runbook executed on a non-prod host
Host inventory sheet with owners and criticality

levels.title: Fleet & Identity
levels.goal: Manage multiple hosts with config management, directory services, and monitoring

topics.title: Directory services
items: Centralized sudo and SSH access patterns

topics.title: Monitoring
items: Host metrics: CPU, memory, disk, and process health
Alerting that pages the right person

projects: Ansible baseline role applied to 3+ VMs
Central auth for SSH/sudo via directory or SSO pattern
Zero/low-downtime patch window for a small HA pair

levels.title: Platform Administration
levels.goal: Design resilient, automated infrastructure with IaC, DR, and security baselines

topics.title: Terraform & lifecycle
items: Provisioning compute, network, and storage as code

topics.title: Golden images & scale
items: Autoscaling groups and cattle not pets

topics.title: Disaster recovery
items: RTO/RPO definitions that match business need
DR drills with measured restore times

topics.title: Operating a platform
items: Capacity and cost conversations with leadership
Handing self-service safely to application teams

projects: Terraform module set for a small environment (net + compute + DNS)
DR tabletop + timed restore of a critical service
Hardening baseline with automated compliance checks
On-call runbook pack and postmortem template for the team
